problem: V213 allowed exact event-mask dedupe 'inside and across shards' without qualifying the event domain. Empty masks, or coincident event encodings, could therefore alias configurations from different assets/sides/timeframes despite representing different hypotheses and opportunity sets.

correction.canonical_mask_bytes: concatenation of sorted unique 32-byte signal_event_id digests
correction.within_domain: exact mask equality may alias; representative is lexicographically smallest SIGNAL_CONFIG_ID
correction.across_domain: never collapse hypotheses; aggregate roots/statistics only
correction.zero_event_mask: may alias only within identical asset+side+timeframe domain
correction.N_TESTS: count distinct domain-qualified event-mask classes, not raw configurations and not cross-domain collapsed masks

precedence: Overrides only V213 GA1 cross-shard dedupe scope; all frozen signal configurations and event semantics remain unchanged.
